smoldoc:stt_8__wtttttttrhspahitiwiwtatai.p: When part of the body is hurt, the body's system that fights disease sends white blood cells to that place.
w: the material that body parts are made of

smoldoc:stt_8__wtttttttrhspahitiwiwtatai.p: These cells give out chemicals that make the blood vessels wider and let more through.
The liquid forms a clear, watery swelling called edema.
w: swelling caused by liquid collecting in the body

smoldoc:stt_8__wtttttttrhspahitiwiwtatai.p: They also give out chemicals that make new tissue grow.
The usual signs of sudden inflammation are redness, heat, swelling and pain.
w: redness, heat and swelling in a hurt part of the body

smoldoc:stt_8__wtttttttrhspahitiwiwtatai.p: Heat is caused by more blood flowing and by the chemicals of inflammation being released.
But if it is severe or lasts too long, it can harm healthy tissue.
Sometimes sudden inflammation can lead to long-lasting inflammation, a long-term condition that can cause pain, disability and even death.
w: lasting a long time, often for life
a lasting problem that limits what a person can do

smoldoc:stt_8__wtttttttrhspahitiwiwtatai.p: Several things can cause sudden inflammation, including infection, injury and diseases where the body attacks itself.
w: diseases where the body attacks its own healthy parts

smoldoc:stt_8__wtttttttrhspahitiwiwtatai.p: Infections are caused by bacteria, viruses or fungi.
w: tiny living things that can cause disease

smoldoc:stt_8__wtttttttrhspahitiwiwtatai.p: When these living things get into the body, they can make the body's defence react and cause inflammation.
w: the body's reaction to fight a germ

smoldoc:stt_8__wtttttttrhspahitiwiwtatai.p: Sudden inflammation is usually treated with medicines that relieve pain, such as ibuprofen or acetaminophen.
w: a common medicine for pain and swelling
paracetamol, a common medicine for pain and fever

smoldoc:stt_8__wtttttttrhspahitiwiwtatai.p: Sometimes corticosteroids may be used to reduce the inflammation.
w: strong medicines like cortisone that reduce swelling

smoldoc:stt_8__wtttttttrhspahitiwiwtatai.p: If the inflammation is caused by an infection, antibiotics may be ordered by the doctor.
It is often caused by autoimmune diseases, such as rheumatoid arthritis and Crohn's disease.
w: a disease that makes the joints swollen and painful
a long-term disease that inflames the gut

smoldoc:stt_8__wtttttttrhspahitiwiwtatai.p: Long-lasting inflammation can also be caused by being very overweight, smoking and dirty air.
w: being very overweight in a way that harms health

smoldoc:stt_8__wtttttttrhspahitiwiwtatai.p: There is no cure for long-lasting inflammation, but it can be controlled with medicine, changes in the way you live, and exercises that help the body.
w: changes in how you live, eat and exercise
